description: Fireghters address a broad spectrum of emergencies, including res, hazardous spills, natural disasters, and rescue operations, leveraging advanced tools such as IoT-enabled devices, AI-based systems, and automated firefighting equipment. They ensure proactive safety measures through inspections and virtual training while maintaining physical and mental readiness to respond effectively to emergencies.
awardingBodyName: Management and Entrepreneurship and Professional Skills Council

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Work effectively in a team as a Firefighter
Maintain health and safety of self and others as a firefighter
Inspect installed Fire safety equipment and systems and ensure their operational readiness
Carry out rescue operations and administer medical First-aid
Respond to the fire incident using firefighting systems
Carry out initial fighting using relevant fire extinguishers
Identify type of fire and response required
